transcript.text: fridge part freezin stuff, lettuce + yoghurts frozen solid at the back. hotpoint ff. any ideas pls

Yes, this is a common problem with fridge-freezers and is often simple to fix, especially when the frozen food was at the back. The likely cause depends on exactly where the frozen items were sitting. From what you have described, the most likely cause is food touching the cold back wall or air outlet. Food pressed against the back wall or right in front of the cold air outlet can freeze even when the fridge is at the right temperature. Was the frozen food touching the back wall or a vent (and have you moved it), or was it clear?
yeah it was right up against the back wall near the vent slots. fridge is rammed after a big shop, stuff pressed against the vent
That fits food touching the cold back wall or air outlet. Once that is sorted, run it again: does it work normally now?
haven't sorted it yet tbh, what should i do?

First the settings: the fridge should be about 3–5°C and the freezer -18°C. Check the dial isn't on its coldest setting and that fast-freeze or super-cool hasn't been left on. Was a setting too cold or a fast-freeze / super-cool mode on (and have you changed it), or was it all set normally?
dial is turned right up to max/coldest, kids may have moved it. no fast freeze that i know of. should i turn it down?

Yes, the dial being on max/coldest would explain food freezing in the fridge, so turn it back to a middle setting rather than all the way down. Hotpoint dials can differ on which end is coldest, so if it isn't marked, check the dial or manual so you move it towards the warmer side. Give it a day with the doors shut to settle at the new setting. Is the food still freezing in the fridge, or is it normal now?
ok will turn it to the middle and move the stuff off the vent. will see how it goes

[Heading: Likely cause: thermostat setting / dial]
The checks point to the thermostat setting / dial. To find the right part, could you give me the model number? It is usually on a sticker inside the fridge, usually on a side wall near the salad drawer.

it starts with H8 but the sticker's partly behind the salad drawer and i cant be bothered emptying it all. do you really need the full number?

[Heading: Likely cause: thermostat setting / dial]
Not for what you're planning now, since turning the dial back to the middle and moving food away from the vent doesn't need it. The full model number only matters if a part turns out to be needed, so you don't have to empty the salad drawer just yet. The checks point to the thermostat setting / dial. If the model number can't be read, it is often also on the guarantee card, the receipt or the manual; with it, the right part can be matched. Without it, an appliance engineer can identify and fit the right thermostat setting / dial from the machine itself.
